data.one_liner: Mixin that runs functions in a separate Dart isolate to keep the UI responsive.
data.what_it_does: Provides an IsolateHelperMixin with a loadWithIsolate method. The method executes a supplied function in a background isolate and returns its result as a Future. It simplifies isolate usage in Flutter apps.
use_when: You need to perform CPU‑intensive work without blocking the main thread
You want a quick way to offload data processing or API calls to an isolate
avoid_when: The task is trivial and doesn’t justify isolate overhead
Running on platforms that don’t support isolates (e.g., web)
strengths: Very easy to integrate via a mixin
Works with Flutter plugins and multiple platforms
weaknesses: Provides only basic isolate handling, no advanced error or cancellation features
